description: Reject multipart form submissions on PHP applications that do not require multipart forms or uploads.
affected_versions: PHP releases before 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12 in their respective release branches; consult PHP/vendor advisories.
coverage: Blocks declared multipart/form-data requests through Aegis, reducing exposure to multipart startup and session-upload-progress paths.
limitations: Partial mitigation only. Does not cover application-driven memory exhaustion, other stale-state consumers, non-multipart paths, oversized/uninspectable header facts, origin bypass or PHP Windows cURL outbound Brotli decoding. Update PHP and apply official configuration guidance.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate file uploads and multipart forms, including forms without files. Do not apply to applications requiring them.
